title: Start with the basics
description: Set up Python, learn how notebooks work, understand files and folders, and get comfortable asking for help.
outcome: You can run a notebook and explain what each step does.

title: Work with data
description: Practice loading, cleaning, filtering, and describing a small dataset with Python and pandas.
outcome: You can turn a raw table into a clear first observation.

title: Learn the research habit
description: Read an accessible paper, identify its question and evidence, and keep notes that someone else can follow.
outcome: You can summarize a study without losing its important limitations.

title: Build a small project
description: Choose a question, find or collect appropriate data, make a simple analysis, and share what you learned.
outcome: You have a small, explainable project to discuss with the committee.
